related.title: 巴德拉太陽能園區
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴德拉太陽能園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bhadla Solar Park must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦向農民租地的光電園區：每戶的租金收入、區塊外送與租金調升；巴德拉太陽能園區則以極端高溫下的千萬瓩級園區：電價與每 MW 收入、沙塵暴的風載重與無水清潔為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A solar park on land leased from farmers: lease income per household, block evacuation and escalating rent; Bhadla Solar Park centres on A gigawatt-scale park in extreme heat: tariff and revenue per megawatt, wind load in sandstorms and waterless cleaning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電池溫度與功率損失」的模型移到巴德拉太陽能園區，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直交流比與削峰」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Cell temperature and power loss" to Bhadla Solar Park, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "DC/AC ratio and clipping", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴德拉太陽能園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bhadla Solar Park must be respecified.

related.title: 卡穆提太陽能電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；卡穆提太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kamuthi Solar Power Project must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦向農民租地的光電園區：每戶的租金收入、區塊外送與租金調升；卡穆提太陽能電廠則以八個月蓋好的 648 MW 電廠：施工速率、逆變器區塊與直流電纜壓降為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A solar park on land leased from farmers: lease income per household, block evacuation and escalating rent; Kamuthi Solar Power Project centres on A 648 MW plant built in eight months: construction rate, inverter blocks and DC cable voltage drop, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電池溫度與功率損失」的模型移到卡穆提太陽能電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「組串設計與低溫開路電壓」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Cell temperature and power loss" to Kamuthi Solar Power Project, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "String design and cold open-circuit voltage", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；卡穆提太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kamuthi Solar Power Project must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 帕瓦加達太陽能園區
history.text: 2015 年邦政府核准園區計畫；2016 年開始向農民租地；2018 年首批 600 MW 併網；2019 年園區全部完工。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2015: The state government approved the park. 2016: Leasing of land from farmers began. 2018: The first 600 MW was connected. 2019: The park was fully completed. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
